description:
Modernize the legacy 'AdmissionQueue.java' file by using Eclipse's 'Infer Generic Type Arguments' refactoring tool. The project 'LegacyHospitalSystem' is located at ~/eclipse-workspace/LegacyHospitalSystem.

Your task:
1. Open the 'LegacyHospitalSystem' project in Eclipse.
2. Open 'src/com/hospital/core/AdmissionQueue.java'. You will see raw type warnings (e.g., 'List is a raw type') and unnecessary explicit casts.
3. Select the 'AdmissionQueue' class or file, right-click, and choose 'Refactor > Infer Generic Type Arguments...'.
4. Apply the refactoring to convert raw collections (List, ArrayList) to type-safe generics (List<Patient>, ArrayList<Patient>) and remove unnecessary casts.
5. Run the unit tests (Right-click project > Run As > JUnit Test) to ensure the code still works.
6. Save the file.
